test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight classmates J, K, L, M, N, O, P and Q were sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant to one another. N was sitting fourth to the left of L. P was sitting fourth to the left of J. O was sitting to the immediate right of N. K was sitting second to the left of P. Only J was sitting between L and M. Which classmate was sitting fourth to the left of M?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: N was sitting fourth to the left of L. O was sitting to the immediate right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff4940539e21a6fac3c165d6e4f145185bbaeac04bb67e93f42b1d7b1e96a60.png] 

We place L at any spot then place N fourth to the left of L. Now we place O to the immediate right of N.

Step 2: Only J was sitting between L and M. P was sitting fourth to the left of J. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d1c9c970c26de85fb6efb8c7ae35fa280c7b27f56de9746ffbc59cff3f0b938.png] 

We place J & M such that J sits between L and M also we have to place them such that P can be placed fourth to the left of J. 

Step 3: K was sitting second to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9158a4786f57dd9aadfdfbb08f6b665515f5cdb447fbda23f3fded75e12927.png] 

Now we place K second to the left of P. At last, we place Q in the only place left.

From the arrangement, we can see that **Q is sitting fourth to the left of M.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 1)**
